description: This PHP script manages the export of platform definitions in the TestLink project, including initializing arguments, setting up GUI parameters, performing the export to XML, and checking user rights.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and validates input arguments, retrieves test project name from database, and sets default export filename.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up GUI configuration parameters for the export page, including filename, title, and URL.

methods.name: doExport
methods.description: Performs the export of platform data to an XML file based on the test project ID.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights to view the platform data.
